context: Sachiko and Goro take an autumn evening walk.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、秋の夕方、綺麗ね。
lines.en: Grandpa—the autumn evening is so beautiful.
lines.style: Warm opening with genuine delight. Soft, unhurried pace. Voice settles into appreciation, like she's sharing something precious. Tender at the edges.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: Yes. A season that becomes quiet.
lines.style: Measured, philosophical acceptance. Slow deliberate pacing on each phrase. Deep and present—the voice of someone sitting with beauty. Gentle certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 一緒に、歩く時間、楽しい。
lines.en: The time we spend walking together is what I love most.
lines.style: Tender and direct. Slight warmth at the opening word. Relaxed pace that lets each phrase breathe. Honest simplicity without performance.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: It's become such a precious daily habit.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Weight on the word 'precious' without emphasis—just true. Slow, unhurried delivery. The voice of someone who has learned what matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ずっと、続けたい、こうして。
lines.en: I want us to keep doing this, just like this, always.
lines.style: Soft and true. Opens gently, slight catch of tenderness midway. Slow trailing into the wish. Voice carries both present joy and fear of losing it.
